intro: Austria is one of the strongest skiing nations on Earth, and has produced champions in motor racing and football.

chapters.title: Skiing
text: Austrian skiers have won more Alpine skiing World Cup races than any other nation. Marcel Hirscher won eight overall World Cup titles in a row, and Hermann Maier and Annemarie Moser-Pröll are legends. Innsbruck hosted the Winter Olympics in 1964 and 1976.

chapters.title: Racing and football
text: Niki Lauda won three Formula One titles and returned to racing weeks after a terrible crash in 1976. Austria co-hosted Euro 2008 with Switzerland, and Dominic Thiem won the US Open in 2020.

keyTerms.meaning: Downhill ski racing, including slalom and downhill events.
